text: {"memo": "Costco Wholesale /NEW (COST) as of March 31, 2025. In the most recently completed fiscal year, ended December 31, 2024, Costco generated net sales of about $242.8 billion, up roughly 8% from $219.7 billion in fiscal 2023. Net income rose to about $5.68 billion from $4.57 billion in fiscal 2023, while diluted EPS increased to about $12.84 from $10.08. Fiscal 2024 operating margin was roughly 4.4%, compared with about 3.8% in fiscal 2023. Revenue growth slowed versus the prior year but remained strong, helped by comparable sales up around 5% and resilient traffic. Cash flow from operations was robust, about $13.4 billion in fiscal 2024, though the exact figure should be checked. Costco continued to build cash and short-term investments. In fiscal 2022, revenue was about $177.2 billion and net income was $6.29 billion, with EPS of $14.07, reflecting a much higher margin environment. Fiscal 2021 revenue was about $142.1 billion and net income was $4.31 billion, or $9.82 per share. The business has shown resilient earnings power, though input costs and membership renewal trends warrant monitoring. View: At roughly $12.84 diluted EPS for fiscal 2024, COST remains a premium-growth retail compounder, but valuation and consumer resilience are key risks."}
